title: Handwriting
description: Text that writes itself stroke by stroke in a handwriting font, from any font's outlines, with optional harfbuzz shaping for ligatures and complex scripts.

props.name: font
props.description: A Tegaki font bundle. Caveat (SIL OFL 1.1) ships with the package; make others in the Tegaki studio, from fonts whose license allows it.

props.name: time
props.description: Leave unset to play once. A number of seconds or a percentage holds a frame (controlled); "css" reads the time from a CSS variable.

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description: Under reduced motion the finished text appears at once. Labs default; the renderer's own default is "never".

props.name: timing / pressure / quality / plugins / seed
props.description: Stroke speed and stagger, pen pressure, render quality, ink plugins (glow, taper, gradients) and the random seed, passed to Tegaki.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called when the text has been written.

props.name: as / ...props
props.description: The element to render and its attributes.

a11y: The text stays real, selectable text in an overlay, so screen readers and search read it once; the drawn canvas is aria-hidden.
Follows prefers-reduced-motion by default: the finished text appears without the writing animation.
Decorative motion only: it never moves layout, so nothing on the page shifts while it writes.
